_comment: A film of a DESKTOP app, as data. One file is the source for the voice, the
camera and the captions, so they cannot drift apart.
The difference from the web version: `control` names a real Windows control
instead of a CSS selector.
"control": "SendButton"        by AutomationId  (preferred - stable)
"control": "name:Send"         by the text the user sees
READ THE REAL AutomationId OFF THE APP with FlaUInspect or Accessibility
Insights. Guessing one is how a film ends up pressing the wrong thing, and
the Filmer refuses rather than guessing for you.
"do": "press" | "type:some text" | "select:Option" | "check" | "hold"
zoomScale: how close, 2.0 at most. The zoom is done afterwards as a crop,
so it always returns to the wide shot - there is no way to leave it stuck.
How fast the film goes, in ONE place. These three numbers were in three
different files - the pause was written as 800 in record.js and as 0.8 in
assemble.js - and three copies of a number are three chances for the
picture and the voice to drift apart.
lengthScale is Piper's --length-scale: above 1.0 speaks slower. 1.0 was
the first film, which the owner found too fast to follow.
sentenceSilence is Piper's --sentence-silence: breath BETWEEN sentences,
which is most of what makes a voice sound like a person rather than a
list being read out.
pauseSeconds is the gap the recorder holds, and the silence assemble.js
puts between lines. They must be the same number or the film drifts.
Which engine speaks, and in which voice.
kokoro: an 82M model, Apache-2.0, CPU-only, read off its model card on
2026-10-17. Chosen because the owner found Piper mechanical. Its own
VOICES.md grades af_heart A and af_bella A-; the best male voice it offers
is a C+, which is worth knowing before anybody asks for a man's voice.
piper: still supported and still here. It covers far more languages and is
tiny. Set engine to 'piper' and the two piperVoices are used instead.
speed is Kokoro's own multiplier - below 1.0 is slower. Piper's equivalent
is the lengthScale in the pacing block, which is not the same number and
is deliberately kept separate.

The owner listened to four Kokoro voices on 2026-10-17 and chose am_michael. Its own VOICES.md grades that voice C+ against af_heart's A - the owner was told that and chose it anyway, which is his call to make and not Claude's: Claude cannot hear any of them.

demo.title: <Your app> — what it does
_comment: THE FIVE RULES, each learned by showing a film to somebody:
1. Say it over something MOVING. Over 20s of still shots is refused.
2. Zoom no closer than 2.0x. A control is identified by its neighbours.
3. One idea per beat.
4. Only claim what is on screen - if the line says it saved, press Save.
5. Keep the example data ordinary. An inflated number is the first thing
somebody who knows the subject notices.

say.en: Welcome to <your app>: one sentence on what it is and who it is for.
say.es: Bienvenido a <su aplicación>: una frase sobre qué es y para quién es.

say.en: Describe the part of the window the ring is around, while the camera moves in and back out.
say.es: Describa la parte de la ventana que rodea el anillo, mientras la cámara se acerca y se aleja.

say.en: Name the button, say what pressing it does, and let the camera pull back to show the result.
say.es: Nombre el botón, diga qué hace al pulsarlo, y deje que la cámara se aleje para mostrar el resultado.
